'''Purong''' was a [[Color/Legends|pale]]-skinned [[Ganimed]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] present at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]<ref name="Cantina Pop-Up" /> in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> before [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="date">''[[The Mos Eisley Cantina Pop-Up Book]]'' shows that [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] was alive when Purong visited [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]. Since [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which is set in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', depicts Greedo's [[Death/Legends|death]], Purong must have gone in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] before 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> During one visit to the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], Purong engaged in a [[Lightfight|shootout]] with the [[Ariwook]] [[Rff Huff]]. The Ganimed wore [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Clothing/Legends|shorts]], a vest with a [[Bandolier/Legends|bandolier]], a band around the left wrist, and brown [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. Purong also carried two [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] in [[Holster/Legends|holsters]] around the hip.<ref name="Cantina Pop-Up">''[[The Mos Eisley Cantina Pop-Up Book]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Purong appeared in [[1995]]'s ''[[The Mos Eisley Cantina Pop-Up Book]]'', written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]] and illustrated by [[Ralph McQuarrie]]. Purong appears in the pop-up spread at the end of the book.<ref name="Cantina Pop-Up" />
